records.gapSource: packages/api/v1/implementation.ts — no idempotency-key header support on POST /api/v1/documents or POST /:id/send

packages/signing/index.ts getSigner — no key-rotation hook; module-level mutable singleton holds the active signer
packages/lib/server-only/webhooks/trigger/trigger-webhook.ts — payload is signed with HMAC but no replay-protection timestamp window enforced on receiver side, no documentation
packages/lib/server-only/recipient/create-envelope-recipients.ts — no per-recipient rate limit on resend; resend-document.ts iterates without throttle
packages/prisma/schema.prisma ApiToken.expires; no service/cron filters by expires
packages/lib/server-only/organisation/create-organisation-member-invites.ts — VerificationToken.expires set to 1 hour for password reset but invite tokens use cuid with no expiry
packages/lib/server-only/webhooks/trigger/trigger-webhook.ts; packages/lib/jobs/definitions/internal/execute-webhook.handler.ts — no dead-letter queue, no admin UI to inspect failed WebhookCalls
packages/api/v1/implementation.ts createDocumentFromTemplate — no validation that template.userId/teamId === requester
packages/lib/server-only/recipient/update-recipient-next-reminder.ts; reminderSettings JSON in DocumentMeta — no upper bound, no clamping; comments mention 3-level cascade
packages/lib/server-only/user/disable-user.ts; absence of ApiToken cascade delete trigger
